visual_style.primary_map: Actual Google Maps capture supplied by root; no invented replacement basemap.
visual_style.orientation: North up throughout; no map rotation during the close signal shot.
visual_style.ambulance: One clearly recognizable white ambulance with a red cross and a stable cyan halo, anchored to recorded positions.
visual_style.ordinary_traffic: Small neutral white or gray vehicle silhouettes, anchored to recorded positions and rotated by recorded SUMO angle.
visual_style.selected_route: One cyan route; thin neutral ghost alternatives only for the initial two seconds.
visual_style.signals: Conventional red/amber/green lamp icons for individual incoming approaches, with short stopline leader lines. Never color the entire junction green.
visual_style.labels: No explanatory sentences or dashboard. Optional route letters, forecast ETA numbers, H icon, and a tiny time-scale indicator.
visual_style.request_icon: Separate from the physical traffic lamp: small crossed request ring for an actual refusal, cyan checked ring for admission while the lamp stays red.
visual_style.hospital_after_arrival: Small persistent H-check icon may remain during the return to PCL; it indicates mission arrival, not traffic recovery.

after_arrival.scope: These are observed ordinary signal-service cycles. They do not demonstrate that earlier priority caused the queue or that all traffic effects have disappeared.

camera_architecture.attention: One cyan ambulance, one cyan chosen route, one H destination. Ghost alternatives fade during this hold.
Carry the same cyan halo into the close shot; never fade it out or move it independently of its physical position.
Camera remains still while the request, physical red-to-green change and queue movement are read.
Follow the actual ambulance. Widen smoothly to medium scale, then settle into the hospital view. Do not fly ahead while the ambulance leaves the screen.
camera_architecture.tracking_anchor: Prefer the ambulance near 45–50% horizontal and 55–60% vertical position. Use at most 60–90 ground meters of lookahead; do not use an unbounded fraction of the remaining hospital distance.

camera_architecture.attention: Keep the roundabout, the real final route branch, the ambulance and the H icon visible together. The destination remains the modeled road approach.
H-check appears at arrival and persists. Pull back before moving to a different area.

camera_interpolation.orientation: North up at all times. No rotation and no hard cuts.
camera_interpolation.centers: Interpolate camera centers in Web Mercator coordinates, not screenshot pixels.
camera_interpolation.zoom: Interpolate log(view width), not width linearly.
camera_interpolation.easing: Use smootherstep s(u)=6u^5−15u^4+10u^3 for planned transitions; match zero endpoint velocities to the fixed holds.
camera_interpolation.focus_constraint: For every moving-ambulance frame, keep its recorded position inside the central 68% of the viewport in both axes. If necessary, increase view width or reduce lookahead; never shift the ambulance marker to repair framing.
camera_interpolation.tracking: Tracking can follow a smoothed camera target while the vehicle marker remains at its actual interpolated position. Suppress jitter using recorded trajectory direction over a short window.
camera_interpolation.camera_verification: Sample every output frame to confirm the ambulance is visible before arrival. Do not infer visibility from keyframes alone.

attention_hierarchy: The focused ambulance is always the brightest moving symbol. Its cyan halo and white/red vehicle symbol do not change identity between camera scales.
Only one chosen route remains bright. Initial alternatives are thin neutral ghosts, then fade.
During the close PCL hold, the relevant lamp is the second strongest object; request icons are smaller and separate.
Hospital H is stable at the mapped campus; arrival check refers to the actual road-approach mission endpoint.
Ordinary vehicles and secondary lamps remain quieter. Do not hide their real queues or movement.
Avoid simultaneous route cards, numeric dashboards, pulsing multiple junctions, animated arrows and explanatory sentences.
timing_critique: Twenty seconds is still compressed, but the 6.5-second fixed PCL shot makes the decisive action legible. The 4.5-second journey must track the ambulance at medium scale. The final return flight intentionally misses the first ordinary release; the second release occurs after the camera settles and is the clear ending beat.
